title: BNP Paribas | Corporate retail bank reinvents its digital customer relationship
description: Arnaud Deslandes, company architecture, BNP Paribas Personal Finance  The implementation of a tool like Liferay in an important organization and regulation constrained can prove to be long and difficult.  This involves the involvement of marketing and user experience teams, business architecture, support and technical, development and production bases.  We will see in this presentation how BNP Paribas Personal Finance has set up a "practice" Liferay transverse to the company, going from an incubator bringing together architecture, base and projects to a deployment on multiple professions and geographies.  We will also approach associated governance issues, good practices ... and others.
